name: MedChemEye-FA
description: Benchmark, code and artifacts for Injection Intent Is Not a Label: Re-Execution-Verified Failure Attribution for Multi-Agent Systems. MedChemEye-FA is a benchmark for physically grounded, spatially localized failure attribution over multi-agent structure-based drug design trajectories, built on 513 crystal protein–ligand complexes in 363 sequence-identity families under an audited leakage-controlled split. A step is labelled guilty only if neutralizing its editjectory removes the fault, judged byphysical checks held out from every model input. The archive contains 2,228 trajectorysical states and verified faultlabels, the split manifests and leakage audit, the complete JSON behind every table in the paper, and the framework and scripts that produced them. Every number printed in the paper is recomputable from this archive. Code is released under MIT; data under CC BY 4.0. The 513 source complexes come from the PoseBusters benchmark set and the Astex Diverse tion is recorded in LICENSE-DATA.txt.
